# Lyriix Android 0.2.15

- Privacy mode keeps only anonymous listening time, with private hours in your statistics. It syncs with your paired PC running Lyriix 1.0.14 or newer over Wi-Fi. Offline devices keep their last setting until connected.
- Add the Lyriix player widget to your home screen for album art and Previous, Play/Pause and Next controls. Private listening uses the Lyriix icon.
